name: Miki Castle
text: Miki Castle (三木城,, Miki-jō) was a Japanese castle in Miki,  Hyōgo Prefecture, Japan. It was built by Bessho Nagaharu in the Sengoku period. Today some ruins and a partial reconstruction remain at the castle site, and its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site, since 2013.

depictions.name: Miki Castle
depictions.text: Miki Castle (三木城) was a Japanese castle in Miki during the Sengoku period. The castle served as the seat of power for its builder, the daimyō Bessho Nagaharu of the Bessho clan, until his downfall and subsequent death in 1580. Today, its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2013.
